title: Red Mask
deck: Thirteen posters for a horror franchise that never existed.
lede: To build the world of an independent feature, Ritesh Films commissioned the one-sheets of a horror franchise that never was: 13 films over 25 years, each poster true to its year.
challenge: “Red Mask” is an independent feature in production with Ritesh Films. Its story needed the history of an imagined horror franchise, and that history had to look real on screen.
work: Each of the 13 posters is conceived as an artifact from a specific year across a 25-year arc, researched to match the visual language of its era: the typography and color palette, the taglines, the distributor marks and the printing conventions of the period.

The series opens with “Red Mask: Night of Blood” (1982) and “Red Mask Part 2” (1984), and closes with “Red Mask 13: Unlucky Strike” (2007). Along the way the numbering changes the way real franchises do, from “Red Mask 4: Trail of Terror” to “Red Mask VII: Karina's Revenge” and “Red Mask X: Beyond the Mask.” Together, the set works as a graphic timeline inside the film's world.
system: Type, color and print conventions matched to each poster's year.
Titles, numbering, taglines and distributor marks that change over 25 years.
credits: Dalton Corr: poster design and period research
